linkedin:
> Per RFC 9110, the server hit an unexpected condition that stopped it fulfilling the request.

It is a deliberately generic catch-all, so the code itself carries no diagnostic value. What it does tell you is valuable by elimination: your application process was alive, accepted the request, ran, and raised something it could not handle. A dead or unreachable process does not produce a 500, it produces a 502 or a 503.
